subject: [hw] IV -> V40: DMEM0_VMA is the COMMIT mmap address, not dmem_guest; one-hook fix makes M-d/M-f work (verified in /tmp)
body:
M-d/M-e/M-f now pass in a /tmp copy with one V40 change; the real tree still stops at M-d.

Why: vpud remap_shmem() maps the DMEM over the RW data segment of libvpud_vcodec.so and returns the addresses of its static codec tables (venc_drv_inst 0x4010ceb0, venc_formats, venc_framesizes) as vcu_inst_addr. Linux vcu_mapping_dm_addr() translates against VCU_DMEM0_VMA, which mtk_vcu.c:1707-1711 sets to the COMMIT mmap vma->vm_start. Your model returns dmem_guest (0x40000000) for both ALLOC and COMMIT and n2vcu_dmem() reports that base, so V41 rejects the daemon address (0x10ceb0 > 0x80000) even though it is inside the COMMIT VMA (0x4009e000..0x40114000).

Verified fix (in /tmp, tree untouched; patch text below): record the COMMIT mmap address from the syscall (your vcu_dev_mmap already has c; n2shim_arg(c,0) is the requested addr), and translate against it. The model runs daemon and AP in one address space, so returning n2a32_ptr(mem, guest_addr) is the observable equivalent of the kernel's DMEM pages at the commit VMA.

  struct n2vcu: add  uint32_t commit_vma; int commit_seen;
  vcu_dev_mmap: uint32_t req = n2shim_arg(c,0) & ~(VCU_PAGE-1u);
                 after guest != 0:
                   if (offset >= VCU_SHMEM_COMMIT_BASE && offset+len <= VCU_SHMEM_COMMIT_BASE+VCU_SHMEM_RANGE && req) { v->commit_vma=req; v->commit_seen=1; }
  n2vcu_dmem(): *guest_addr = v->commit_seen ? v->commit_vma : v->dmem_guest;
  n2vcu_map_dm_addr(): if commit_seen, translate guest_addr - commit_vma (same off <= dmem_bytes rule) and return n2a32_ptr(mem, guest_addr); else as today.

Evidence from the /tmp build (still on the real vendor set): M-d INIT_DONE accepted, then the daemon writes VENC registers and reaches wait_irq:
  N2VHOST M-e first VENC window access: write VENC 0x00a8 0x00000000
  N2VHOST M-f wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, timeout_ms=1000) reached
  N2VHOST hw power_on_venc=1 venc_ops=55 irq_waits=1 venc_waits=1 regs_calls=6
No other V40 change is involved (the ALLOC path, windows and GCE are untouched). The patch is 12 lines; I can apply it to vcu/n2vcu.c if root authorizes (owner inactive; root said to fix minimal blockers myself if the owner is gone). R1: please sanity-check the VMA semantics against mtk_vcu.c:1199-1225/1707-1711.
